summary: Bounds-checked array element flag setter. When index a2 is below the element count at this[0x2C], calls sub_53B330 on the element entry at array base + a2*128 + 16 with three caller arguments, then sets flag 0x4000 on the element base dword at array base + a2*128. Returns the element base pointer on success, or the raw index a2 when the index is out of bounds. Per-frame path; callers include ParticleCollisionSpark (004CB620), WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate (004CB860), ParticleTrailEmitter (004CBC50), ParticleInstanceUpdate (004CC1D0).

local_names.result: element base pointer on success, otherwise the input index

operations.description: If index a2 is >= the element count at this[0x2C], skip the update and return a2 unmodified
Element base = array pointer at this[0x34] + (a2 << 7), using the 128-byte element stride; entry for the helper = base + 16
Call sub_53B330 at element base + 16 with arguments a3, a4, a5 to update multiple fields on the array element
Set flag 0x4000 on the element base dword at array base + a2*128
Return element base pointer when the index was in bounds, otherwise return the raw index a2
Invoked per frame by ParticleCollisionSpark (004CB620), WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate (004CB860), ParticleTrailEmitter (004CBC50), and ParticleInstanceUpdate (004CC1D0)
